title: CLI: Add `storybook ai` command for init prompts
description:
Closes # ## What I did This pull request introduces a new "AI initialization" feature to the Storybook CLI, enabling automated project analysis and setup instructions for Storybook via a new `aiInit` command. It also adds support for agent-driven initialization flows and enhances telemetry tracking. The changes include new modules for AI prompts and project introspection, updates to initialization logic, and the extension of telemetry and project metadata types. ## Checklist for Contributors ### Testing #### The changes in this PR are covered in the following automated tests: - [ ] stories - [ ] unit tests - [ ] integration tests - [ ] end-to-end tests #### Manual testing - ### Documentation - [ ] Add or update documentation reflecting your changes - [ ] If you are deprecating/removing a feature, make sure to update [MIGRATION.MD](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/blob/next/MIGRATION.md) ## Checklist for Maintainers - [ ] When this PR is ready for testing, make sure to add `ci:normal`, `ci:merged` or `ci:daily` GH label to it to run a specific set of sandboxes. The particular set of sandboxes can be found in `code/lib/cli-storybook/src/sandbox-templates.ts` - [ ] Make sure this PR contains **one** of the labels below:
Available labels - `bug`: Internal changes that fixes incorrect behavior. - `maintenance`: User-facing maintenance tasks. - `dependencies`: Upgrading (sometimes downgrading) dependencies. - `build`: Internal-facing build tooling & test updates. Will not show up in release changelog. - `cleanup`: Minor cleanup style change. Will not show up in release changelog. - `documentation`: Documentation **only** changes. Will not show up in release changelog. - `feature request`: Introducing a new feature. - `BREAKING CHANGE`: Changes that break compatibility in some way with current major version. - `other`: Changes that don't fit in the above categories.
### 🦋 Canary release This pull request has been released as version `0.0.0-pr-34345-sha-055a0e2e`. Try it out in a new sandbox by running `npx storybook@0.0.0-pr-34345-sha-055a0e2e sandbox` or in an existing project with `npx storybook@0.0.0-pr-34345-sha-055a0e2e upgrade`.

## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added a top-level "ai" command with an "ai prepare" subcommand that emits AI-assisted Storybook setup guidance (renders detailed markdown for eligible projects). * Interactive AI option during project creation, plus --agent/--no-agent flags for automated/non-interactive flows; agent mode can auto-run AI setup. * AI setup auto-selects a recommended AI-related addon when chosen and is gated to React+Vite projects. * **Tests** * Expanded test coverage for AI prompts, agent/non-interactive flows, and gating behavior.

_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟡 Minor_

**Restore `process.stdout.isTTY` after the suite.**

Line 95 resets `process.stdout.isTTY` for intra-file isolation, but nothing restores the original descriptor after the last test. Because several later cases set it back to `true`, this file can leave the worker in interactive mode and make unrelated CLI tests flaky. Save the original descriptor once and restore it in an `afterAll` hook.

Object.defineProperty(process.stdout, 'isTTY', originalIsTTY); else
Object.defineProperty(process.stdout, 'isTTY', { value: undefined, configurable:
true }); })); update the existing reset that uses
Object.defineProperty(process.stdout, 'isTTY', { value: undefined, configurable:
true }) to only change the value during tests while relying on the afterAll hook
